deficiencies.description: The rewrite converts the lecturer's pointing words ('the tumor is here. This is the outer surface of the uterus') into a specific spatial description ('lies next to the outer surface of the uterus') that is not stated in the text.
deficiencies.sourcePassage: You can see that the tumor is here. This is the outer surface of the uterus.
deficiencies.rewritePassage: The tumour lies next to the outer surface of the uterus

considerations.sourcePassage: So you can see again that this is actually circumspect and very separate from the surrounding stroma and the surrounding tissue.
considerations.reason: The rewrite replaces 'circumspect' with 'circumscribed'. Although not listed in corrections, 'circumspect' is an obvious speech-to-text error for the standard pathological description 'circumscribed', and retaining the error would hinder student learning.

considerations.sourcePassage: So if you zoom into what this actually looks like on the slide, taking this section here, what you find is normal muscle here, but interleaving within that, you have these stripes of the malignant tumor that are within the normal muscle.
considerations.reason: The rewrite renders 'taking this section here' as 'In a zoomed-in view of the section', which accurately preserves the meaning without adding unsourced anatomical or pathological facts.
